# Muchova/Mensik win 2026 US Open mixed doubles title

Adesina O. Koiki/

Wednesday, August 26, 2026

Text Size:

-

+

WHAT HAPPENED

The all-Czech duo of Karolina Muchova and Jakub Mensik are the new US Open mixed doubles champions after defeating Belinda Bencic and Flavio Cobolli, 6-3, 1-6, [10-6], in the final of the 2026 US Open Mixed Doubles Championship presented by Vital Proteins® inside Arthur Ashe Stadium on Wednesday night. [...] “It’s my first time standing here,” Mensik said after both he and Muchova won their first Grand Slam title in any discipline. “I didn’t expect this before the tournament, but it’s such great fun. It was amazing to play and start the US Open like that.”

Arthur Kapetanakis/

Monday, August 31, 2026

Text Size:

Carlos Alcaraz, Aryna Sabalenka and Amanda Anisimova were among the winners on Monday at the 2026 US Open, while Stefanos Tsitsipas scored a big upset against 10th seed and Cincinnati champion Arthur Fils. In the evening session, Naomi Osaka, Ben Shelton, Iga Swiatek and Frances Tiafoe all advanced.
